caption: We set up Wholesale 20 percent, a 20% rule for customers tagged wholesale, in about 2 minutes. It saved as Active. The store name is hidden.
The app preview priced Bundle Product #1 at $1,105.60 under the rule. We did not log in as a tagged shopper on the live storefront. The store name is hidden.
On a development store Kumo runs on an unlimited Developer plan, so the B2B ($15 a month) and PLUS ($30 a month) Select buttons were greyed out and we tested no paid limits. The store name is hidden.
Uninstalling B2B Wholesale Tools, the app's name in Shopify, deletes data it manages such as discounts.
The uninstall went through and Shopify confirmed it. Shopify's yellow bar also lists the app as not yet compatible with market-driven shipping.
